notes: Windows updater repair. This release keeps the 6.1.5 direct DONE relay and replaces the installer handoff with a robust bootstrapper that detects the exact running David.exe location, closes any remaining David processes, backs up the previous program as David-last-good.exe, replaces that exact program with 6.1.6, and relaunches it. The update still checks, downloads, and verifies directly from the official GitHub Software-Updates channel inside David.
